semiconductor_relevance: High — Y.A.C. Mechatronics Co., Ltd. specializes in manufacturing equipment for semiconductor processes, including test handlers and cleaning systems.
summary: Y.A.C. Mechatronics Co., Ltd. produces a range of semiconductor equipment, including test handlers and precision cleaning systems. Their SC Division focuses on automation systems for both front-end and back-end semiconductor processes, while the WP Division specializes in cleaning and drying equipment for semiconductor manufacturing.
